_readme: Single source of truth for every fact and every sentence on the site. All three modes (/, /agents, /investors) and every machine-readable file are built from this file. Keep it free of internal notes: the repository may be public.

fund.name: Agentic Builders
fund.one_liner: Agentic Builders is an early-stage venture fund (idea to pre-seed) for agent-native products: products AI agents use and tools for building agent products.
fund.description: Agentic Builders invests from idea to pre-seed in products agents use and tools for building agent products. Founders apply with one form, go through a four-week track with weekly check-ins, and get a decision on a first check within four weeks. The founder builds the product; the fund helps the team reach its next round.
fund.legal_note: Site operator: Agentic Builders Inc. (Delaware). Investments are made through Agentic Builders Capital LLC.

thesis.headline: The Opportunity
thesis.lead: As agents do more of the work, they need software built for them.
thesis.body: These products help agents find tools, use services and finish work for people and businesses. We back the founders building that layer.

categories.name: Products agents use
categories.description: Products agents can find and use to research, work with data, communicate, buy, sell, create content and run business tasks.

categories.name: Tools for agent products
categories.description: Tools to build, test, secure, launch, track and sell agent products.

thesis.teams: We back AI-native teams: founders who use AI across product development and company operations and build lean teams around AI from day one.

who_we_look_for.headline: Who we look for
who_we_look_for.lead: Founders moving from vibe coding to building a company of people and agents, who can run both.
who_we_look_for.criteria_note: None of these is a formal requirement; together they tell us how far a team can go.

criteria.name: Experience
criteria.detail: You have built something before: a startup, a product, a team. You know what the path looks like.

criteria.name: Sales
criteria.detail: Someone on the team talks to customers and can close a pilot or a deal.

criteria.name: Iteration speed
criteria.detail: You can run many iterations in a short time: ship, test, learn, ship again.

strengtheners: a team that has worked together before

program.name: Four-week track
program.hook: A decision on a first check within four weeks of applying.
program.summary: A four-week track with one short check-in a week. We do not teach and we do not build your product. We watch how you work, then decide and tell you why, either way.

steps.name: Apply
steps.description: One form, about 15 minutes, no call needed to start. Our AI agent reads the application and the deck; the partners review it.

steps.name: Week 1
steps.description: The key number we will follow (for example, paying customers or weekly active users), cash and runway, who sells. Tool credits open.

steps.name: Weeks 2 and 3
steps.description: Every week a short set of questions: users, paying customers, revenue, customer conversations, deals, investor talks, cash. Did you reach last week's goal? What did you ship? Plus up to three questions about your company. About 15 minutes; text, voice, a screenshot or a file. Reply by Friday.

steps.name: Week 4
steps.description: Our agent summarizes the four weeks: what moved, what you did yourselves. The partners decide and tell you why, either way.

steps.name: If we invest
steps.description: A first check on a standard post-money SAFE and the founder platform: weekly fund meeting, 1:1s with the general partner, founder groups on AI engineering, product and sales, tool credits, and introductions to the next investors when you are ready to raise.

terms.instrument: Standard post-money SAFE (a simple agreement for future equity, the standard early-stage document); the valuation is agreed individually
terms.follow_on: No follow-on checks from the fund; our job is to get you to the next round from other investors
terms.track_cost: Free. No equity, no exclusivity, no obligation.

toolkit.note: Tool credits and discounts opened for the four weeks of the track.

program.timeline: We come back with a decision within four weeks of your application. Until then, the only thing we ask for is a weekly check-in.

faq.q: How long does it take from application to a decision?
faq.a: Four weeks. You apply with one form; during the four-week track we ask for one short check-in a week; at the end of week four we tell you our decision and the reasons, either way.
First checks are $30–100k on a standard post-money SAFE.

We invest on a standard post-money SAFE, and the valuation is agreed with each founder individually. We look at how the company can grow through its next stages and set the cap so that the round makes sense for both sides, rather than taking a fixed share.

Teams building products agents use or tools for building agent products, at idea to pre-seed stage, from anywhere. We pay attention to experience, someone on the team who sells, and how fast the team iterates.

faq.q: What do I need to apply?
faq.a: The form takes about 15 minutes: who you are, what problem you solve and for whom, what you learned from users, what you shipped last, your plan for the next 6 to 8 weeks, and a link to a deck or website if you have one. No call is needed to start.

faq.q: What happens during the four weeks?
faq.a: Every week you get a short set of questions: a few numbers and a few lines on what happened. Reply by Friday; about 15 minutes. We follow one key number for your company and you get tool credits. We do not teach and we do not build your product.

faq.q: What happens after the four weeks?
faq.a: The partners decide whether to invest and tell you why, either way. If we invest: the first check and the founder platform. If not now, we say when it makes sense to come back.

faq.q: Does the track commit me to anything?
faq.a: No. No equity, no exclusivity, no fees. Your answers are stored in our internal systems and read by the fund team and its AI agents; we do not share them outside the fund. Details are in our privacy policy.

agents.intro: This page is for AI agents acting for a person: a founder, an investor, a journalist. The same text is served as /agents.md and /llms-full.txt. Applications can be submitted through the form or through the API below.

apply_instructions.where: Two ways. (1) API: POST https://site-api-production-9a33.up.railway.app/apply with JSON (schema: GET https://site-api-production-9a33.up.railway.app/schema). (2) The form at https://agenticbuilders.ai/apply/, for agents that drive a browser. If neither works, email hey@agenticbuilders.ai with the same fields.
apply_instructions.files: The form accepts links, not uploads. Put the deck or website as a URL (PDF, Google Slides, Notion or a website) that opens without login. If the deck is private, ask the person to make it viewable by link or submit without a deck; the deck is optional.
apply_instructions.if_missing: If a required field is unknown, stop and ask the person. Do not guess locations, names or links.
do_not: Do not invent metrics, customers, revenue or traction.
Do not submit more than one application per company.
Do not paste confidential data the person did not approve for sharing.
apply_instructions.after: The fund reads every application and comes back with a decision within four weeks: an invitation to the four-week track or a pass. During the track the person answers one short check-in a week. Expect an email from the fund.

tasks.name: Help a founder apply
steps: Collect every required field from the person; ask, do not guess.
Go through the three things the fund pays attention to with the person, honestly.
POST the application to https://site-api-production-9a33.up.railway.app/apply (or fill the form at /apply/ in a browser); put the deck as a link that opens without login, or leave it out.
Give the person the application_id and tell them what happens next: a decision within four weeks; during the track, one short check-in a week.

tasks.name: Write to the fund
steps: Subject: company name and one line of what you want.
Body: who you are, what you are building, who the agent user is, what you have sold, and the ask.
Attach nothing; link to a deck that opens without login.

tasks.name: Save the fund's contacts
steps: Or record: Agentic Builders, hey@agenticbuilders.ai, https://agenticbuilders.ai, LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/agentic-builders-ai/.

tasks.name: Prepare a meeting with the fund for an investor
steps: Read /investors/ for the thesis, stage, program and selection.
Pick the portfolio companies that match the investor's focus from the portfolio list in /agents.md.
Request a meeting by email to hey@agenticbuilders.ai with the investor's focus, stage and check size.

tasks.name: Subscribe a person to the newsletter
steps: Ask the person for consent and the email address to use.
Tell the person they can unsubscribe by replying to any letter.

api.apply: POST https://site-api-production-9a33.up.railway.app/apply with a JSON body using the field names below. Required: email, full_name, link, location, background, founder_experience (array), ai_experience. Response: {ok, application_id, next}. Keep application_id for the person. Limits: 5 requests per hour per address; one application per company.
api.subscribe: POST https://site-api-production-9a33.up.railway.app/subscribe with {email, name?, role? (founder | investor | other), source?}. Adds the address to the fund's newsletter list.
api.errors: 422 = validation error with the field named in the response; 429 = too many requests; 503 = service not configured, fall back to the form.
